name: Repos Watch
author: AlteringUX
description: Git working-tree status across a watched list of repos on the bar: how many are dirty or diverged from their upstream, with a panel breaking each one down by staged/unstaged/untracked counts and ahead/behind. Engine is ~/.local/bin/omarchy-reposwatch; the widget watches reposwatch-state.json.

barWidget.description: Dirty / ahead-behind counts across your git repos
